Sandbox_ChopTreeXP_EnableStrength_toolti: Each tree hit of the automatic Chop Tree action grants Strength XP like one burpee rep (4.8).
Sandbox_ChopTreeXP_StrengthMultiplier_to: Multiplier on the per-hit Strength XP (4.8). Applied before the server XP multipliers.
Sandbox_ChopTreeXP_EnableAxe_tooltip: Each tree hit grants Axe XP proportional to the tree health it removed, so every axe gives the same Axe XP per tree (about 3 per Fire Axe hit). Axe-category weapons only.
Sandbox_ChopTreeXP_AxeMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier on the Axe XP. Applied before the server XP multipliers.
Sandbox_ChopTreeXP_EnableFitness_tooltip: Each tree hit grants Fitness XP like one burpee rep (3.2).
